Which permissions do I need?

Create a fine-grained token, choose only your target repository, and allow Contents, Workflows, and Actions: read and write. Set a short expiration. No token is needed for the daily cloud runs.

Create an empty repository with a README first if you need one. For creation inside this app, a classic token with repo + workflow scopes is an alternative with broader access. Organization policies may restrict either method.
